notes.title: [NEW RELEASE] How to Cope with Boredom & Loneliness (FREE)
notes.notes:
Today we release our second game on Steam, How to Cope with Boredom & Loneliness: A Guide for the Isolated. A completely free, no strings attached game!

Harold Fletcher has been grounded to his bedroom for over 30 years. Join award-winning journalist Nigel Wimble as he discovers how one man has coped with the boredom and loneliness from the years of isolation in this one of kind documentary film simulator!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30836111/565a07f615bdef1ba3206a4d4806a0882d5fe7fc.png[/img]

How to Cope with Boredom & Loneliness is a very short, simple concept which is more of a cartoon generator than a game. But that's not to say it isn't fun! We hope it makes you laugh and enjoy it for what it is.

The game will serve as the first in a series of projects we are dubbing 'The Weirdos of Wallow Dale'. Watch out for more odd games in the coming months! 

Have fun and let us know what you think!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/797390/How_To_Cope_With_Boredom_and_Loneliness/
